# Navilesh Bhatti

> Navilesh Bhatti is a student web and game developer from Rupnagar, Punjab, India. He builds web apps and games with React, Node.js and Firebase, takes freelance web projects, and is currently writing a video editor from scratch.

Official website: https://navileshbhatti.xyz/

## Projects
- [Klyro](https://navilesh-creat.github.io/Klyro/): free toolkit of browser tools (PDF merge, image compression, QR codes, JSON and CSV converter, text diff). No login, files never leave the device.
- [Dominion of Arkenfold community portal](https://navilesh-creat.github.io/Arkenfold-constitution/): constitution reader, member directory and announcements for a community, with Firebase sign-in.
- Other work: gravity-drift and FixFlow on GitHub.
